questions.prompt: Match each example to its data bucket
questions.explanation: Quant = structured numbers. Qual = text and judgement. Alt = neither, and increasingly where edge lives.

questions.prompt: A backtest decides on 1 January using that same year's full-year earnings. Which bias?
questions.explanation: Those earnings weren't published until months later. The strategy is time-travelling.

questions.prompt: Why did Abraham Wald recommend armouring the places where returning bombers had NO bullet holes?
options: Planes hit there never returned to be counted
questions.explanation: Classic survivorship logic: the sample excludes the casualties.

questions.prompt: A transaction dated 1970-01-01 almost always means:
options: A missing timestamp defaulting to the Unix epoch
questions.explanation: Unix time starts 1970-01-01. Systems default there when a timestamp is absent.

questions.prompt: Which quality pillar is violated when nobody can explain where a reported KPI came from?
questions.explanation: Lineage is the traceable path from source through every transformation.

questions.prompt: Extreme crisis observations should be removed from financial datasets as outliers.
questions.explanation: A crisis is not an outlier — it is often the observation that matters most.

questions.prompt: A deposit-behaviour model trained on 2010–2019 fails badly in 2023. Most likely bias?
questions.explanation: Near-zero rates gave way to the fastest hiking cycle in decades — a structural break.

questions.prompt: Why can't AI certify a dataset as 'reliable' from a pasted sample of 20 rows?
options: The sample is too small statistically
Reliability comes from provenance — source, lineage, what's missing — none of which is visible in a sample
It can, if you ask nicely
questions.explanation: Inspection can reveal defects; only provenance establishes trust.

questions.prompt: Name two free sources this course uses for Indian prices and macro data.
options: yfinance (.NS tickers) and RBI DBIE / MOSPI
questions.explanation: yfinance for NSE prices, RBI's DBIE and MOSPI for Indian macro series.

questions.prompt: MoneyMart's FY20-21 revenue was first reported as ₹3,511 cr and later restated to ₹3,366 cr. Using the restated figure in a model of 2021 decisions is which bias?
questions.explanation: Point-in-time: you must model what was believed at the time, not what was later corrected.
